page.layout: One block of running text at the top of the page, full width, with no notes or other columns. Below it the page is blank apart from show-through, which is left out. Page number printed at the head.

main_text.p: atq; [?]sinet. Quod ad fidem attinet, eam tibi polliceor summam: & ne quid cauillari (non enim dicam calumniari) possis, tua recitabo uerba: & quantum per tui typographi industriam mihi licet, locum designabo. Ad rem aggrediamur.

page.notes: The first word of the page reads "sinet" in the scan, with a long-s form that could be an f; I have written it as sinet with [?]. The printed line reads "licet,locum" with no space after the comma; I have kept the printed form as far as the layout allows. The line-end hyphens in "polli-ceor", "di-cam", "li-cet" and "ag-grediamur" are joined into "polliceor", "dicam", "licet" and "aggrediamur". Show-through from the other side of the leaf below the text is left out.
